plan.title: Extend Submission Time in RFQ Evaluation

steps.note: Open the existing prepared event instead of creating or searching for another event.
Assert the Settings menu offers Extend Submission Time and that it is clickable.
Click the offered action to open its extension dialog.
Assert that selecting the action opens the Increase Event Time window.
Cancel the dialog so no submission-time change is committed.
Assert the dialog closed after cancellation.
